summary: Backend-only testing of Thermal Casting LLP API. Executed 26 pytest cases covering health, company profile, JWT auth (admin/customer/register/me/invalid), products (list/categories/filter/search/detail/media/404), media (list/videos/brochure filter), RFQ (guest create, authenticated linkage, my, admin-only listing, per-RFQ permission incl. cross-user 403, admin-only patch + persistence), AI chat via Claude Sonnet 4.5 through Emergent LLM (grounded on ISO/IBR/BHEL + history persistence), admin stats, and WordPress adapter (status + graceful sync when WP not configured). 26/26 passed (100%).

minor.issue: Email is silently lowercased server-side (line 210). Not a bug, but not documented; clients that expect exact casing preservation should be informed.

Ref-no generator uses count_documents()+1 (line 306-309); under concurrent inserts this can collide and produce duplicate ref_nos. Consider an atomic counter (findAndModify on a counters collection) — non-blocking for current tests.

action_items: Consider using an atomic counter for RFQ ref_no to avoid race collisions in production.
Frontend .env exposes EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL (used by Expo) — expected. No EXPO_BACKEND_URL key present; tests fall back to the public URL from test_credentials.md.
AI chat endpoint is POST-only (non-streaming). Frontend must call POST /api/ai/chat (not SSE) — matches server implementation.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 726 lines — approaching the 700-line split threshold; consider splitting into routers (auth.py, products.py, media.py, rfq.py, ai.py, admin.py).
Deprecated FastAPI @app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown') used (lines 716, 723). Should migrate to lifespan context managers.
All Mongo reads correctly project out _id — good.
Passwords hashed via bcrypt (passlib CryptContext) — good.
JWT_SECRET default in .env is human-readable; fine for dev but must be rotated in production (already documented in the value).
seed_data_creation: None created directly. Tests exercise seeded admin/customer/products/media/company. All test-generated data prefixed with TEST_.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend base: https://casting-master-dna.preview.emergentagent.com/api. Seeded admin/customer creds in /app/memory/test_credentials.md. Emails are lowercased server-side on register/login. RFQ ref_no format RFQ-YYYY-NNNNN. AI chat is non-streaming POST /api/ai/chat returning {reply, session_id}; history via GET /api/ai/history/{session_id}. WP adapter returns configured=false when env not set and /api/admin/wp/sync returns {status:'ok'|'error', counts:{...}} without crashing.
rca_of_issue: No blocking bugs. Only test-side casing mismatch initially observed (register lowercases email); test assertions updated to case-insensitive comparison. All 26 tests now pass.
